verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to expect from an incident-management SaaS, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents a Rootly CLI. The 'Gemini CLI' mentions refer to a third-party MCP client. The '/rootly summary' command is a Slack slash command, not a CLI. The MCP server and REST API are separate capabilities or developer building blocks, so none of them counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
